post.description:
Flow B step 1: begin cross-email SSO account linking.
The SSO token is validated via the Authorization header. Returns an Auth0 authorization URL
that the UI should redirect the browser to so the user can authenticate their existing account.
The SSO sub is signed into the OAuth state parameter — no cookie required.

get.description:
Shared Flow B callback for both API and admin flows.
Recovers the SSO sub (and optional redirect_to) from the signed state, exchanges the code,
and links the two Auth0 identities. Returns JSON for API callers; redirects for admin callers.

post.description:
Flow C: create a new Passport user from an SSO identity.
Called when a user logs in via SSO and confirms they have no existing Passport account.
